name: Krell
canonNotes: A Chaos Champion of Khorne from before Sigmar's birth, whose name fills the Dwarfs' Great Book of Grudges; slain at Karak Kadrin and later raised by Nagash.
Killed again by Sigmar and imprisoned, then freed by Heinrich Kemmler, who believes Krell serves him; Krell's older allegiance to Nagash is not easily broken.
voiceNotes: Few words, dreadful and martial; speaks as an ancient warlord of blood and the grave.
Hatred for Dwarfs and Sigmar's heirs; loyal, in the end, only to Nagash.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
